description: IBGE - BC100 - ES - BARRAGEM is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). (METADADOS REPLICADOS DE A classe Barragem faz parte da categoria Hidrografia da Base Cartográfica Contínua do Estado do Espírito Santo, na escala 1:100.000 (BC100ES) que compõe o conjunto de dados geoespaciais de referência, estruturados em bases de dados digitais, permitindo uma visão integrada do território nessa escala. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are features, hid_barragem_l_31984, Espirito Santo, inlandWaters. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
